<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Adds SketchSSM ([paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33051)) for Mamba-2 layers with Triton kernels, behind `--sketchssm`. SketchSSM builds on ReplaySSM (#48018): the state is still updated exactly once per window of W steps, and the other decode steps read a compact sketch of the state instead of the full state, cutting state-access traffic by about 10x at the default mean rank 8. NemotronH is wired up.

## Claims

- New `--sketchssm <calibration file or HF repo>` option for Mamba-2 decode (`NemotronHForCausalLM`), with `--sketchssm-mean-rank` to pick the sketch size at load time.
- Faster decode of Mamba-2 models: on Nemotron-3-Nano-4B (one RTX PRO 6000, batch 256), end-to-end decode is 2.75x faster than the default decode and 1.8x faster than ReplaySSM. The paper reports results for Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 and Nemotron-3-Super (NVFP4).
- Accuracy preserved: GSM8K 82.9 ± 0.8 vs 82.9 ± 1.2 for the default decode (3 seeds); the paper shows mean rank 8 matches the full-state baseline on MATH-500, AIME25, GPQA Diamond and LiveCodeBench.
- Compatible with the rest of the stack: only the decode of the Mamba-2 layers changes. Prefill runs the default chunk scan, the attention and MLP layers are untouched, and model weights and weight-side optimizations (e.g. quantization) are unaffected. Mamba prefix caching works in align mode, and tensor parallelism splits the heads' ranks and the group frames across ranks.
- Without `--sketchssm`, behaviour is unchanged.

## Validation

Nemotron-3-Nano-4B with [`SketchSSM/Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16`](https://huggingface.co/SketchSSM/Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16) (mean rank 8, W=16) on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (sm_120). ReplaySSM (Triton) requires Model Runner V1; the others run on V2.

| | Decode, batch 256 | Speedup | GSM8K 5-shot (3 seeds) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| default | 38.2 ms/step | 1.00x | 82.9 ± 1.2 |
| ReplaySSM (V1) | 25.5 ms/step | 1.50x | 83.4 ± 0.9 |
| SketchSSM | 13.9 ms/step | 2.75x | 82.9 ± 0.8 |

```bash
python benchmarks/sketchssm/e2e_decode_speedup.py --sketchssm-mean-rank 8 --batch-size 256
# GSM8K against `vllm serve <model> --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float32 --sketchssm SketchSSM/Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16`
python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --num-shots 5 --temperature 0.6 --top-p 0.95 --seed {0,1,2}
```

Tests:

- Unit and kernel tests: decode, flush and prefill state rotation against FP64 references, calibration loading and rank allocation, tensor-parallel sharding of the ranks and frames, metadata, config validation.
  `pytest tests/kernels/mamba/test_sketchssm_mamba2.py tests/model_executor/test_sketchssm_calibration.py tests/v1/attention/test_sketchssm_metadata_builder.py tests/v1/worker/test_mamba_hybrid_model_state.py tests/test_config.py`
- E2E (2 passed, new "(H100) SketchSSM E2E" CI step): `tests/v1/e2e/test_sketchssm_decode.py` checks that SketchSSM logprobs stay close to the default decode on Nemotron-3-Nano-4B, with and without align-mode prefix caching.
- Prefix caching on Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2: align-mode cached outputs match the uncached ones token for token, also under `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`.
- Tensor parallelism (TP=2, two RTX PRO 6000): SketchSSM logprobs on Nemotron-3-Nano-4B stay close to the default decode at TP=2 (`check_logprobs_close`, as in the E2E test).

## Details

- **Motivation.** At serving batch sizes, decode of hybrid models is bound by reading each request's recurrent state (Mamba-2: heads x head_dim x state_size FP32 per layer). ReplaySSM (#48018) writes the state only once per window of W steps; SketchSSM also avoids reading it on the other W-1 steps. The [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33051) covers the algorithm and its accuracy.
- **Design decisions.**
  - *Exact flushes, sketched reads.* The flush is ReplaySSM's exact window update, so sketch error does not carry across windows; only the reads inside a window are approximate.
  - *Rotated, key-major state.* The state is kept in a calibrated orthogonal frame per group, key-major, so a head's sketch is its leading rows. Decode rotates only the query (and the window keys at a flush). Prefill runs the default chunk scan and rotates the final states, so prefill matches the default path.
  - *Ranks allocated at load.* The calibration file holds rank-score curves; `--sketchssm-mean-rank` allocates per-head ranks once at startup (CPU), so the accuracy/traffic budget changes without recalibrating. `layer_ids` in the file maps calibration rows to model layers.
  - *Reuse ReplaySSM.* The rings, write positions, flush flags and B·C precompute kernel are shared. SketchSSM adds sketch rows, flush rows and prompt-completion flags to the Mamba metadata; flush rows (state update and sketch rebuild in one kernel) run on the aux stream next to the sketch reads.
  - *Model Runner V2 only.* Sketches are indexed by the persistent request index (`req_idx`) of MRV2.
- **Tradeoffs.**
  - Reads inside a window are approximate, so accuracy depends on the mean rank. The default, mean rank 8, is near-lossless in the paper (average accuracy matches the full-state baseline on all four models).
  - Extra memory outside the KV cache: per-layer sketch buffers for `max_num_seqs` requests, about 6% of the FP32 state at mean rank 8 (4.8 MiB per request for Nemotron-3-Nano-4B, 7.9 MiB for Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2).
  - A per-model calibration file is needed (published for several models on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/SketchSSM), or made with [SketchSSM](https://github.com/SNU-ARC/SketchSSM)).
- **Limitations.**
  - Not supported yet (rejected at config time): speculative decoding, KV connectors, a non-FP32 SSM cache, stochastic rounding, `--mamba-backend` other than triton, Model Runner V1, and Mamba prefix caching other than align mode.
  - Requires CUDA with compute capability 8.0 or newer, a Mamba-2 state size that is a power of two (at least 16) and a head dim of at least 16.
  - The Triton launch configs in `ops/sketchssm_config.py` (like `replayssm_config.py`) are tuned on an RTX PRO 6000 (sm_120) for now; configs tuned on other GPUs will be added to this file.
- **Follow-ups (planned).**
  - Optimized CUDA decode kernels for Mamba-2 SketchSSM: vLLM will use them when the `sketchssm` package is installed (`pip install sketchssm`), and fall back to the Triton kernels otherwise.
  - Support for other linear attention architectures, including Gated DeltaNet and KDA.
  - Support for the features rejected at config time today: speculative decoding, KV connectors, a BF16 SSM cache, stochastic rounding, other `--mamba-backend` options, and Mamba prefix caching beyond align mode.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""End-to-end decode benchmark: SketchSSM vs ReplaySSM vs the standard SSM decode.
+
+Loads a hybrid Mamba-2 model, replicates one prompt across the batch, and times
+a long greedy decode (CUDA graphs on) with each mode in its own subprocess. All
+modes use an FP32 SSM cache; standard and SketchSSM run on Model Runner V2, which
+SketchSSM requires, and ReplaySSM (Triton) on Model Runner V1, which it requires.
+
+Example:
+    python benchmarks/sketchssm/e2e_decode_speedup.py \\
+        --model-id nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16 \\
+        --sketchssm SketchSSM/Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16 --sketchssm-mean-rank 8
+
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+DEFAULT_PROMPT = "My cat wrote all this CUDA code for a new language model and"
+MODES = {"standard": "standard", "replayssm": "ReplaySSM", "sketchssm": "SketchSSM"}
+
+
+def parse_args():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
+    p.add_argument("--model-id", default="nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16")
+    p.add_argument("--sketchssm", default="SketchSSM/Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16")
+    p.add_argument("--sketchssm-mean-rank", type=float, default=None)
+    p.add_argument("--prompt", default=DEFAULT_PROMPT)
+    p.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=256)
+    p.add_argument("--num-steps", type=int, default=1000)
+    p.add_argument("--warmup-steps", type=int, default=128)
+    p.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=1)
+    p.add_argument("--buffer-len", type=int, default=16, help="Window length W.")
+    p.add_argument("--gpu-memory-utilization", type=float, default=0.9)
+    p.add_argument("--modes", nargs="+", choices=list(MODES), default=list(MODES))
+    p.add_argument("--worker", choices=list(MODES), help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
+    return p.parse_args()
+
+
+def run_worker(args) -> None:
+    os.environ["VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER"] = "0" if args.worker == "replayssm" else "1"
+    import torch
+
+    from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
+
+    max_model_len = args.num_steps + 256
+    llm_kwargs = dict(
+        model=args.model_id,
+        max_model_len=max_model_len,
+        trust_remote_code=True,
+        enable_prefix_caching=False,
+        enable_chunked_prefill=False,
+        max_num_seqs=args.batch_size,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=max(max_model_len, args.batch_size * 64),
+        disable_log_stats=True,
+        gpu_memory_utilization=args.gpu_memory_utilization,
+        mamba_ssm_cache_dtype="float32",
+    )
+    if args.worker == "replayssm":
+        llm_kwargs.update(use_replayssm=True, replayssm_buffer_len=args.buffer_len)
+    elif args.worker == "sketchssm":
+        llm_kwargs.update(
+            sketchssm=args.sketchssm,
+            sketchssm_mean_rank=args.sketchssm_mean_rank,
+            replayssm_buffer_len=args.buffer_len,
+        )
+    llm = LLM(**llm_kwargs)
+    prompts = [args.prompt] * args.batch_size
+
+    def timed_generate(n_tokens: int) -> float:
+        params = SamplingParams(
+            temperature=0.0, ignore_eos=True, min_tokens=n_tokens, max_tokens=n_tokens
+        )
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        start = time.perf_counter()
+        outs = llm.generate(prompts, params, use_tqdm=False)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        assert min(len(o.outputs[0].token_ids) for o in outs) == n_tokens
+        return time.perf_counter() - start
+
+    timed_generate(args.warmup_steps)
+    elapsed = min(timed_generate(args.num_steps) for _ in range(args.repeats))
+    print(
+        "RESULT_JSON "
+        + json.dumps(
+            dict(
+                mode=args.worker,
+                per_step_ms=elapsed / args.num_steps * 1e3,
+                tok_s=args.batch_size * args.num_steps / elapsed,
+            )
+        ),
+        flush=True,
+    )
+
+
+def run_mode(args, mode: str) -> dict:
+    cmd = [sys.executable, __file__, "--worker", mode]
+    for name in (
+        "model_id",
+        "sketchssm",
+        "sketchssm_mean_rank",
+        "prompt",
+        "batch_size",
+        "num_steps",
+        "warmup_steps",
+        "repeats",
+        "buffer_len",
+        "gpu_memory_utilization",
+    ):
+        value = getattr(args, name)
+        if value is not None:
+            cmd += [f"--{name.replace('_', '-')}", str(value)]
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
+    if proc.returncode != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"mode {mode!r} exited with {proc.returncode}")
+    for line in proc.stdout.splitlines():
+        if line.startswith("RESULT_JSON "):
+            return json.loads(line[len("RESULT_JSON ") :])
+    raise RuntimeError(f"mode {mode!r} produced no result")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    args = parse_args()
+    if args.worker is not None:
+        run_worker(args)
+        return
+    print(
+        f"model={args.model_id} batch_size={args.batch_size} "
+        f"steps={args.num_steps} W={args.buffer_len} "
+        f"sketchssm={args.sketchssm} mean_rank={args.sketchssm_mean_rank}"
+    )
+    results = [run_mode(args, mode) for mode in args.modes]
+    base = results[0]["per_step_ms"]
+    print(f"{'mode':<12}{'ms/step':>10}{'tok/s':>14}{'speedup':>10}")
+    for r in results:
+        print(
+            f"{MODES[r['mode']]:<12}{r['per_step_ms']:>10.3f}"
+            f"{r['tok_s']:>14,.0f}{base / r['per_step_ms']:>9.2f}x"
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+# SketchSSM
+
+SketchSSM speeds up the decode of Mamba-2 layers in Mamba-2 based models. Each request decodes in windows of `W` steps (`--replayssm-buffer-len`, 16 by default). The last step of a window flushes the window into the exact FP32 state and rebuilds a compact per-request sketch of it; the other steps read the sketch instead of the full state. Dense heads (rank 0) keep BF16 rows of their full state instead, built with the sketch at the flush and after prefill. During decode the FP32 state stays exact and changes only at flushes.

+"""SketchSSM Mamba-2 decode (Triton kernel) against FP64 references.
+
+The state lives in random per-group frames; B and C arrive unrotated and the
+references rotate them in FP64.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.ops import sketchssm_mamba2_build as sk
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.ops import sketchssm_mamba2_decode as skd
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="Requires CUDA")
+
+H, P, G, N, NULL = 32, 32, 8, 128, 0
+RANKS = ([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 20, 38, 64] * H)[:H]  # dense, maps, pivots
+
+
+def flush_row_list(is_flush: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``(batch,)`` int32 indices of the flush rows, then -1 padding."""
+    rows = torch.full_like(is_flush, -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    idx = torch.nonzero(is_flush).flatten()
+    rows[: idx.numel()] = idx.to(torch.int32)
+    return rows
+
+
+def sketch_read(s: torch.Tensor, q: torch.Tensor, m: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Four-pivot residual-diagonal read of state ``s`` (P, N) with ``q``."""
+    if m == 0:
+        return s @ q
+    norm = s / s.square().sum(0).mean().sqrt()
+    dirs: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+    for u in norm[:, : min(m, sk.SKETCH_PIVOTS)].T:
+        v = u.clone()
+        for d in dirs + dirs:
+            v -= d * (d @ v)
+        keep = v.square().sum() > 1e-12 * u.square().sum()
+        dirs.append(v / v.norm() if keep else torch.zeros_like(v))
+    z = torch.stack(dirs) @ norm
+    residual = (norm.square().sum(0) - z.square().sum(0)).clamp_min(0)
+    residual[: len(dirs)] = 0
+    metric = torch.diag(residual) + z.T @ z
+    ridge = sk.SKETCH_RIDGE * torch.eye(m, dtype=s.dtype, device=s.device)
+    return s[:, :m] @ torch.linalg.solve(metric[:m, :m] + ridge, metric[:m] @ q)
+
+
+def stored_read(sketch: sk.SketchArgs, meta: int, h: int, q: torch.Tensor):
+    """Read of head ``h`` with ``q`` from the stored sketch row ``meta``."""
+    t, m = sketch.tables, RANKS[h]
+    U = sketch.u[meta, int(t.u_offsets[h]) :].double()
+    if m == 0:
+        return U[:N].T @ q
+    w_off, ag_off = int(t.w_offsets[h]), int(t.ag_offsets[h])
+    coeff = sketch.w[meta, w_off : w_off + min(m, sk.SKETCH_PIVOTS)].double() @ q
+    if m > sk.SKETCH_PIVOTS:
+        ag = sketch.ag[meta, :, ag_off : ag_off + m].double()
+        coeff = ag[0] * q[:m] + (ag[1:] * coeff[:, None]).sum(0)
+    return U[:m].T @ coeff
+
+
+class Layer:
+    """One layer's state, rings and sketch; the last row pads the batch."""
+
+    def __init__(self, W: int, batch: int = 5):
+        bf16, S = torch.bfloat16, batch + 1
+        self.W, self.batch = W, batch
+        g = self.g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+        rand = lambda *s: torch.rand(*s, generator=g).cuda()  # noqa: E731
+        randn = lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, generator=g).cuda() * 0.1  # noqa: E731
+        # Key-major FP32 state; kernels see the (slot, H, dim, dstate) view.
+        self.state = randn(S, H, N, P).transpose(-1, -2)
+        self.x_cache, self.dt_cache = randn(S, H, W, P).to(bf16), rand(S, H, W) * 0.1
+        self.B_cache, self.A = randn(S, G, W, N).to(bf16), -rand(H) - 0.5
+        self.dt_bias, self.D = (rand(H) * 0.1).to(bf16), rand(H).to(bf16)
+        self.slots = torch.tensor([*range(1, batch), NULL], dtype=torch.int32).cuda()
+        self.meta = torch.arange(batch, dtype=torch.int32).flip(0).cuda()
+        ranks = torch.tensor(RANKS, dtype=torch.int32)
+        shapes = zip(sk.sketch_shapes(ranks, P, N), sk.SKETCH_DTYPES)
+        u, w, ag = (torch.zeros(batch, *s, dtype=d).cuda() for s, d in shapes)
+        frames = torch.linalg.qr(torch.randn(G, N, N, generator=g))[0]
+        frames_t = frames.transpose(-1, -2).contiguous().cuda()
+        self.rot = frames_t.double()  # row vectors rotate as v @ frames_t
+        tables = sk.SketchTables(ranks, N).cuda()
+        self.sketch = sk.SketchArgs(u, w, ag, tables, frames_t)
+        # x, B and C are slices of one row buffer, as in the model.
+        self.conv = torch.empty(batch, H * P + 2 * G * N, dtype=bf16).cuda()
+        self.out = torch.empty(batch, H, P, dtype=bf16).cuda()
+        self.bc_pre = torch.empty(batch, G, W).cuda()
+
+    def inputs(self):
+        self.conv.copy_(torch.randn(self.conv.shape, generator=self.g) * 0.3)
+        x, B, C = self.conv.split([H * P, G * N, G * N], 1)
+        dt = (torch.randn(self.batch, H, generator=self.g) * 0.5).cuda().bfloat16()
+        return x.view(-1, H, P), dt, B.view(-1, G, N), C.view(-1, G, N)
+
+    def build(self) -> None:
+        flags = torch.ones(self.batch, dtype=torch.int8).cuda()
+        sk.sketch_build(
+            self.state, self.slots, self.meta, flags, self.sketch, null_block_id=NULL
+        )
+
+    def step(self, x, dt, B, C, pos, flush):
+        common = dict(
+            state=self.state,
+            x=x,
+            dt=dt[..., None].expand(-1, -1, P),
+            A=self.A[:, None, None].expand(-1, P, N),
+            B=B,
+            query=sk.sketch_query(C, self.sketch.frames_t),
+            D=self.D[:, None].expand(-1, P),
+            dt_bias=self.dt_bias[:, None].expand(-1, P),
+            x_cache=self.x_cache,
+            dt_cache=self.dt_cache,
+            B_cache=self.B_cache,
+            write_pos=pos,
+            state_indices=self.slots,
+            sketch_indices=self.meta,
+            out=self.out,
+            sketch=self.sketch,
+            null_block_id=NULL,
+        )
+        skd.sketch_decode(C=C, bc_pre=self.bc_pre, is_flush=flush, **common)
+        skd.sketch_flush(flush_rows=flush_row_list(flush), **common)
+        return self.out
+
+    def checked_step(self, pos: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        """Decode at ring positions ``pos`` and check against FP64 references."""
+        x, dt, B, C = self.inputs()
+        s0, flush = self.state.double(), (pos == self.W - 1).to(torch.int8).cuda()
+        got = self.step(x, dt, B, C, pos.int().cuda(), flush).double()
+        assert torch.equal(self.state[NULL].double(), s0[NULL])
+        for row, slot in enumerate(self.slots.tolist()[:-1]):
+            p, r = int(pos[row]), H // G
+            dt_cur = F.softplus(dt[row].float() + self.dt_bias.float())[:, None]
+            dts = torch.cat([self.dt_cache[slot, :, :p], dt_cur], 1).double()
+            cs, a = dts.cumsum(1), self.A.double()[:, None]
+            w, decay = dts * torch.exp(a * (cs[:, -1:] - cs)), torch.exp(a * cs[:, -1:])
+            xs = torch.cat([self.x_cache[slot, :, :p], x[row, :, None]], 1).double()
+            ks = torch.cat([self.B_cache[slot, :, :p], B[row, :, None]], 1).double()
+            ks = torch.einsum("gtn,gnk->gtk", ks, self.rot)
+            q = (C[row].double()[:, None] @ self.rot)[:, 0]
+            ks, q = ks.repeat_interleave(r, 0), q.repeat_interleave(r, 0)
+            skip = self.D.double()[:, None] * xs[:, -1]
+            if p == self.W - 1:
+                s = decay[..., None] * s0[slot]
+                s += torch.einsum("htp,ht,htn->hpn", xs, w, ks)
+                got_s = self.state[slot].double()
+                torch.testing.assert_close(got_s, s, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
+                want, tol = torch.einsum("hpn,hn->hp", s, q) + skip, [1e-2] * H
+            else:
+                ring = torch.einsum("htp,ht,htn,hn->hp", xs, w, ks, q)
+                # The kernel reads its stored sketch (BF16 output rounding) ...
+                meta = int(self.meta[row])
+                read = [stored_read(self.sketch, meta, h, q[h]) for h in range(H)]
+                want = decay * torch.stack(read) + ring + skip
+                err = (got[row] - want).abs().amax(1) / want.abs().amax(1)
+                assert (err < 5e-3).all(), (row, p, err)
+                # ... which holds the four-pivot read up to BF16 storage.
+                read = [sketch_read(s0[slot, h], q[h], m) for h, m in enumerate(RANKS)]
+                want = decay * torch.stack(read) + ring + skip
+                tol = [2e-2 if m == 0 else 5e-2 for m in RANKS]
+                assert torch.equal(self.state[slot].double(), s0[slot])
+            err = (got[row] - want).abs().amax(1) / want.abs().amax(1)
+            assert (err.cpu() < torch.tensor(tol)).all(), (row, p, err)
+
+
+def test_sketchssm_mamba2_decode():
+    """Sketches built from the prefilled states serve rows at mixed window

+    W = 16
+    layer = Layer(W)

+    assert not layer.sketch.u[int(layer.meta[-1])].any()  # padding row
+    for t in range(W + 1):
+        layer.checked_step((t + torch.tensor([0, W // 2 + 1, W - 1, 3, 0])) % W)
+
+
+def test_sketchssm_rotate_states():
+    """Prefill states rotate into the cache frame and back."""
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)

+    back = sk.sketch_rotate_states(key_major, frames_t, inverse=True)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(back, states, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""SketchSSM for Mamba-2: sketch layout, B/C rotations and the sketch build.
+
+The state ``S`` is kept key-major, ``(slot, head, dstate, dim)``, in
+coordinates rotated by a calibrated orthogonal frame ``R`` per group. Prefill
+runs the unrotated chunk scan and rotates its states (``sketch_rotate_states``);
+decode rotates only the query ``R C`` (``sketch_query``) and, at a flush, the
+window keys.
+
+A head of rank ``m`` (0 = dense) keeps ``U``, the leading ``m`` rows of ``S``
+(all rows if dense), and reads ``S^T q`` as ``U^T c`` with the ridge solution
+
+    c = (diag(r) + Z^T Z + λI)^-1 (diag(r) + Z^T Z)[:m] q,
+
+where ``Z`` holds the first ``min(m, 4)`` pivot rows of the normalized state
+orthonormalized over ``dim`` and ``r`` the row energy they leave. It is
+stored as ``c_j = a_j q_j + Σ_p g_pj (w_p · q)``: the ``w`` rows in BF16, and
+``a`` and ``g`` in FP32 ``ag`` for ``m > 4`` (for ``m <= 4``, ``a = 0`` and
+``g`` folds into ``w``). Sketch buffers are indexed by the persistent request
+index.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.ops.sketchssm_config import get_sketchssm_config
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import NULL_BLOCK_ID
+
+SKETCH_PIVOTS = 4
+SKETCH_RIDGE = 0.003
+SKETCH_DTYPES = (torch.bfloat16, torch.bfloat16, torch.float32)
+# FP32 dots of the rotations and the flush (3xTF32).
+SKETCH_DOT_PRECISION = "tf32x3"
+
+_PIVOTS = tl.constexpr(SKETCH_PIVOTS)
+_RIDGE = tl.constexpr(SKETCH_RIDGE)
+
+
+def sketch_shapes(
+    ranks: torch.Tensor, head_dim: int, state_size: int
+) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]:
+    """Per-request ``(u, w, ag)`` shapes of one layer."""
+    ranks = ranks.long()
+    u_rows = int(torch.where(ranks == 0, state_size, ranks).sum())
+    w_rows = int(ranks.clamp(max=SKETCH_PIVOTS).sum())
+    ag_cols = int(ranks.sum())
+    return (
+        (max(u_rows, 1), head_dim),
+        (max(w_rows, 1), state_size),
+        (SKETCH_PIVOTS + 1, max(ag_cols, 1)),
+    )
+
+
+class SketchTables(torch.nn.Module):
+    """Per-head ranks and offsets into one layer's packed sketch."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ranks: torch.Tensor, state_size: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        ranks = ranks.to(torch.int32).cpu()
+        u_rows = torch.where(ranks == 0, state_size, ranks)
+        pivots = ranks.clamp(max=SKETCH_PIVOTS)
+        tables = {
+            "ranks": ranks,
+            "u_offsets": u_rows.cumsum(0) - u_rows,
+            "w_offsets": pivots.cumsum(0) - pivots,
+            "ag_offsets": ranks.cumsum(0) - ranks,
+        }
+        device = torch.get_default_device()
+        for name, value in tables.items():
+            self.register_buffer(
+                name, value.to(torch.int32).to(device), persistent=False
+            )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SketchArgs:
+    """One layer's sketch buffers, tables and frames."""
+
+    u: torch.Tensor  # (num_reqs, u_rows, head_dim) bf16
+    w: torch.Tensor  # (num_reqs, w_rows, state_size) bf16
+    ag: torch.Tensor  # (num_reqs, 5, ag_cols) fp32
+    tables: SketchTables
+    frames_t: torch.Tensor  # (groups, state_size, state_size) fp32, R^T
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["num_tokens"])
+def _rotate_groups_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    y_ptr,
+    frames_t_ptr,
+    num_tokens,
+    stride_x_token,
+    stride_x_elem,
+    stride_y_token,
+    stride_y_elem,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_T: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_C: tl.constexpr,
+    DOT_PRECISION: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # y[t, g, cols] = x[t, g] @ R_g^T[:, cols] for BLOCK_C output columns.
+    pid_t = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_g = tl.program_id(1)
+    offs_t = pid_t * BLOCK_T + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_T)
+    offs_n = tl.arange(0, N)
+    offs_c = tl.program_id(2) * BLOCK_C + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_C)
+    mask = offs_t[:, None] < num_tokens
+    x = tl.load(
+        x_ptr
+        + offs_t[:, None] * stride_x_token
+        + (pid_g * N + offs_n[None, :]) * stride_x_elem,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    r = tl.load(frames_t_ptr + pid_g * N * N + offs_n[:, None] * N + offs_c[None, :])
+    y = tl.dot(x.to(tl.float32), r, input_precision=DOT_PRECISION)
+    tl.store(
+        y_ptr
+        + offs_t[:, None] * stride_y_token
+        + (pid_g * N + offs_c[None, :]) * stride_y_elem,
+        y.to(y_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        mask=mask,
+    )
+
+
+def _rotate_groups(
+    x: torch.Tensor, frames_t: torch.Tensor, out: torch.Tensor, block_t: int
+) -> None:
+    # x and out are (tokens, groups * N) with any element stride.
+    num_tokens = x.shape[0]
+    groups, n, _ = frames_t.shape
+    if num_tokens == 0:
+        return
+    block_c = min(n, 64)
+    grid = (triton.cdiv(num_tokens, block_t), groups, n // block_c)
+    _rotate_groups_kernel[grid](
+        x,
+        out,
+        frames_t,
+        num_tokens,
+        x.stride(0),
+        x.stride(-1),
+        out.stride(0),
+        out.stride(-1),
+        N=n,
+        BLOCK_T=block_t,
+        BLOCK_C=block_c,
+        DOT_PRECISION=SKETCH_DOT_PRECISION,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _rotate_states_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    y_ptr,
+    frames_t_ptr,
+    heads,
+    heads_per_group,
+    stride_x_item,
+    stride_x_head,
+    stride_x_dim,
+    stride_x_dstate,
+    stride_y_item,
+    stride_y_head,
+    stride_y_dim,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_P: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_C: tl.constexpr,
+    INVERSE: tl.constexpr,
+    DOT_PRECISION: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # y[i, h, p, cols] = x[i, h, p] @ R_g^T[:, cols] (R_g[:, cols] if INVERSE).
+    item = tl.program_id(0) // heads
+    head = tl.program_id(0) % heads
+    group = head // heads_per_group
+    offs_p = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK_P + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_P)
+    offs_n = tl.arange(0, N)
+    offs_c = tl.program_id(2) * BLOCK_C + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_C)
+    mask = offs_p[:, None] < DIM
+    x = tl.load(
+        x_ptr
+        + item * stride_x_item
+        + head * stride_x_head
+        + offs_p[:, None] * stride_x_dim
+        + offs_n[None, :] * stride_x_dstate,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    frame = frames_t_ptr + group * N * N
+    if INVERSE:
+        r = tl.load(frame + offs_c[None, :] * N + offs_n[:, None])
+    else:
+        r = tl.load(frame + offs_n[:, None] * N + offs_c[None, :])
+    y = tl.dot(x, r, input_precision=DOT_PRECISION)
+    tl.store(
+        y_ptr
+        + item * stride_y_item
+        + head * stride_y_head
+        + offs_p[:, None] * stride_y_dim
+        + offs_c[None, :],
+        y,
+        mask=mask,
+    )
+
+
+def sketch_rotate_states(
+    states: torch.Tensor, frames_t: torch.Tensor, inverse: bool = False
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """States ``(items, heads, dim, N)`` FP32 in the rotated frame, ``S R^T``
+    (``S R`` back to the model frame if ``inverse``).
+
+    Prefill runs the unrotated chunk scan; its states enter the cache rotated.
+    """
+    items, heads, dim, n = states.shape
+    assert states.dtype == torch.float32
+    assert frames_t.is_contiguous()
+    out = torch.empty(states.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=states.device)
+    if items == 0:
+        return out
+    block_p, block_c = 32, min(n, 64)
+    grid = (items * heads, triton.cdiv(dim, block_p), n // block_c)
+    _rotate_states_kernel[grid](
+        states,
+        out,
+        frames_t,
+        heads,
+        heads // frames_t.shape[0],
+        *states.stride(),
+        *out.stride()[:3],
+        DIM=dim,
+        N=n,
+        BLOCK_P=block_p,
+        BLOCK_C=block_c,
+        INVERSE=inverse,
+        DOT_PRECISION=SKETCH_DOT_PRECISION,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+def sketch_query(C: torch.Tensor, frames_t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """FP32 rotated query ``R C`` ``(batch, groups, N)`` of the decode C."""
+    batch, groups, n = C.shape
+    assert C.stride(1) == n * C.stride(2)
+    query = torch.empty(batch, groups, n, dtype=torch.float32, device=C.device)
+    _rotate_groups(C.flatten(1), frames_t, query.view(batch, -1), block_t=32)
+    return query
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _inv_norm(w, u):
+    # 1 / |w|, or 0 when w keeps almost nothing of u.
+    e = tl.sum(w * w)
+    keep = e > 1.0e-12 * tl.sum(u * u)
+    return tl.where(keep, 1.0 / tl.sqrt(tl.where(e > 0.0, e, 1.0)), 0.0)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pivot_scalars(u0, u1, u2, u3, m):
+    # Gram-Schmidt (twice) coefficients of the pivot rows u0..u3.
+    z = tl.sum(u0 * 0.0)
+    e0 = tl.sum(u0 * u0)
+    n0 = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(tl.where(e0 > 0.0, e0, 1.0))
+    p10, p11, n1 = z, z, z
+    p20, p21, p22, p23, n2 = z, z, z, z, z
+    p30, p31, p32, p33, p34, p35, n3 = z, z, z, z, z, z, z
+    v0 = u0 * n0
+    v1 = u0 * 0.0
+    v2 = u0 * 0.0
+    if m > 1:
+        p10 = tl.sum(v0 * u1)
+        w1 = u1 - v0 * p10
+        p11 = tl.sum(v0 * w1)
+        w1 = w1 - v0 * p11
+        n1 = _inv_norm(w1, u1)
+        v1 = w1 * n1
+    if m > 2:
+        p20 = tl.sum(v0 * u2)
+        w2 = u2 - v0 * p20
+        p21 = tl.sum(v1 * w2)
+        w2 = w2 - v1 * p21
+        p22 = tl.sum(v0 * w2)
+        w2 = w2 - v0 * p22
+        p23 = tl.sum(v1 * w2)
+        w2 = w2 - v1 * p23
+        n2 = _inv_norm(w2, u2)
+        v2 = w2 * n2
+    if m > 3:
+        p30 = tl.sum(v0 * u3)
+        w3 = u3 - v0 * p30
+        p31 = tl.sum(v1 * w3)
+        w3 = w3 - v1 * p31
+        p32 = tl.sum(v2 * w3)
+        w3 = w3 - v2 * p32
+        p33 = tl.sum(v0 * w3)
+        w3 = w3 - v0 * p33
+        p34 = tl.sum(v1 * w3)
+        w3 = w3 - v1 * p34
+        p35 = tl.sum(v2 * w3)
+        w3 = w3 - v2 * p35
+        n3 = _inv_norm(w3, u3)
+    return n0, p10, p11, n1, p20, p21, p22, p23, n2, p30, p31, p32, p33, p34, p35, n3
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pivot_directions(
+    u0,
+    u1,
+    u2,
+    u3,
+    n0,
+    p10,
+    p11,
+    n1,
+    p20,
+    p21,
+    p22,
+    p23,
+    n2,
+    p30,
+    p31,
+    p32,
+    p33,
+    p34,
+    p35,
+    n3,
+):
+    # Orthonormal pivot directions v1..v3 from the _pivot_scalars coefficients.
+    v0 = u0 * n0
+    v1 = (u1 - v0 * p10 - v0 * p11) * n1
+    v2 = (u2 - v0 * p20 - v1 * p21 - v0 * p22 - v1 * p23) * n2
+    v3 = (u3 - v0 * p30 - v1 * p31 - v2 * p32 - v0 * p33 - v1 * p34 - v2 * p35) * n3
+    return v1, v2, v3
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _sketch_head(
+    state_ptr,
+    sketch_index,
+    head,
+    u_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    ag_ptr,
+    ranks_ptr,
+    u_offsets_ptr,
+    w_offsets_ptr,
+    ag_offsets_ptr,
+    stride_state_dim,
+    stride_state_dstate,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    DSTATE: tl.constexpr,
+    U_ROWS,
+    W_ROWS,
+    AG_COLS,
+    BLOCK_V: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # Sketch of one head from its state at state_ptr, streamed in dim chunks.
+    j = tl.arange(0, DSTATE)
+    m = tl.load(ranks_ptr + head).to(tl.int32)
+    u_rows = u_ptr + (
+        (
+            sketch_index.to(tl.int64) * U_ROWS
+            + tl.load(u_offsets_ptr + head)
+            + j[None, :]
+        )
+        * DIM
+    )
+    if m == 0:
+        for c in tl.static_range(0, DIM, BLOCK_V):
+            vc = c + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_V)
+            mask = vc[:, None] < DIM
+            s = tl.load(
+                state_ptr
+                + vc[:, None] * stride_state_dim
+                + j[None, :] * stride_state_dstate,
+                mask=mask,
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            tl.store(u_rows + vc[:, None], s.to(u_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+    else:
+        pv = tl.arange(0, triton.next_power_of_2(DIM))
+        pivot = state_ptr + pv * stride_state_dim
+        u0 = tl.load(pivot, mask=pv < DIM, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        u1 = tl.load(pivot + stride_state_dstate, mask=pv < DIM, other=0.0)
+        u2 = tl.load(pivot + 2 * stride_state_dstate, mask=pv < DIM, other=0.0)
+        u3 = tl.load(pivot + 3 * stride_state_dstate, mask=pv < DIM, other=0.0)
+        n0, p10, p11, n1, p20, p21, p22, p23, n2, p30, p31, p32, p33, p34, p35, n3 = (
+            _pivot_scalars(
+                u0, u1.to(tl.float32), u2.to(tl.float32), u3.to(tl.float32), m
+            )
+        )
+        energy = tl.full((DSTATE,), 0.0, tl.float32)
+        cross = tl.full((DSTATE,), 0.0, tl.float32)
+        z1 = tl.full((DSTATE,), 0.0, tl.float32)
+        z2 = tl.full((DSTATE,), 0.0, tl.float32)
+        z3 = tl.full((DSTATE,), 0.0, tl.float32)
+        for c in tl.static_range(0, DIM, BLOCK_V):
+            vc = c + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_V)
+            vmask = vc < DIM
+            chunk = state_ptr + vc * stride_state_dim
+            s = tl.load(
+                chunk[:, None] + j[None, :] * stride_state_dstate,
+                mask=vmask[:, None],
+                other=0.0,
+            ).to(tl.float32)
+            tl.store(
+                u_rows + vc[:, None],
+                s.to(u_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+                mask=vmask[:, None] & (j[None, :] < m),
+            )
+            c0 = tl.load(chunk, mask=vmask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+            energy += tl.sum(s * s, axis=0)
+            cross += tl.sum(c0[:, None] * s, axis=0)
+            if m > 1:
+                c1 = tl.load(chunk + stride_state_dstate, mask=vmask, other=0.0)
+                c2 = tl.load(chunk + 2 * stride_state_dstate, mask=vmask, other=0.0)
+                c3 = tl.load(chunk + 3 * stride_state_dstate, mask=vmask, other=0.0)
+                v1, v2, v3 = _pivot_directions(
+                    c0,
+                    c1.to(tl.float32),
+                    c2.to(tl.float32),
+                    c3.to(tl.float32),
+                    n0,
+                    p10,
+                    p11,
+                    n1,
+                    p20,
+                    p21,
+                    p22,
+                    p23,
+                    n2,
+                    p30,
+                    p31,
+                    p32,
+                    p33,
+                    p34,
+                    p35,
+                    n3,
+                )
+                z1 += tl.sum(v1[:, None] * s, axis=0)
+                if m > 2:
+                    z2 += tl.sum(v2[:, None] * s, axis=0)
+                if m > 3:
+                    z3 += tl.sum(v3[:, None] * s, axis=0)
+        # Normalize by the mean row energy; z0..z3 are the rows of Z.
+        mean = tl.sum(energy) / DSTATE
+        safe_mean = tl.where(mean > 0.0, mean, 1.0)
+        pivot_energy = tl.sum(tl.where(j == 0, energy, 0.0))
+        e = energy / safe_mean
+        z0 = (
+            cross
+            / tl.sqrt(tl.where(pivot_energy > 0.0, pivot_energy, 1.0))
+            / tl.sqrt(safe_mean)
+        )
+        z0 = tl.where(pivot_energy > 0.0, z0, 0.0)
+        z1 = z1 / tl.sqrt(safe_mean)
+        z2 = z2 / tl.sqrt(safe_mean)
+        z3 = z3 / tl.sqrt(safe_mean)
+        residual = tl.maximum(e - z0 * z0 - z1 * z1 - z2 * z2 - z3 * z3, 0.0)
+        residual = tl.where(j < tl.minimum(m, _PIVOTS), 0.0, residual)
+        denominator = residual + _RIDGE
+        a = residual / denominator
+        # g = (I + Z_m D^-1 Z_m^T)^-1 Z_m D^-1 by a Cholesky solve, rows g0..g3.
+        b0 = tl.where(j < m, z0 / denominator, 0.0)
+        g0 = b0 / (1.0 + tl.sum(z0 * b0))
+        g1 = tl.full((DSTATE,), 0.0, tl.float32)
+        g2 = tl.full((DSTATE,), 0.0, tl.float32)
+        g3 = tl.full((DSTATE,), 0.0, tl.float32)
+        if m > 1:
+            b1 = tl.where(j < m, z1 / denominator, 0.0)
+            l0_0 = tl.sqrt(1.0 + tl.sum(z0 * b0))
+            l1_0 = tl.sum(z1 * b0) / l0_0
+            l1_1 = tl.sqrt(1.0 + tl.sum(z1 * b1) - l1_0 * l1_0)
+            y0 = b0 / l0_0
+            y1 = (b1 - l1_0 * y0) / l1_1
+            g1 = y1 / l1_1
+            g0 = (y0 - l1_0 * g1) / l0_0
+            if m > 2:
+                b2 = tl.where(j < m, z2 / denominator, 0.0)
+                l2_0 = tl.sum(z2 * b0) / l0_0

+"""SketchSSM Mamba-2 decode kernels.
+
+A decode step splits the rows by ReplaySSM's flush flag. Non-flush rows
+(``sketch_decode``) read their sketch plus the window ring:
+
+    y = decay · U^T c(R C) + Σ_t s_t (B_t · C) x_t + D x.
+
+Flush rows (``sketch_flush``) fold the window into the rotated state as
+ReplaySSM does, with the FP32 rotated keys ``R B_t``, read it, and rebuild
+their sketches. The two touch disjoint rows, slots and sketches, so they may
+run concurrently. B and C arrive unrotated; the ring keeps the BF16 B and
+``bc_pre`` holds the rotation-invariant ``B_t · C``.
+"""

+@triton.jit
+def _window(
+    dt_cache_ptr,
+    x_cache_ptr,
+    dt_cur,
+    x_cur,
+    A,
+    wp,
+    offs_m,
+    dim,
+    stride_dt_cache_pos,
+    stride_x_cache_pos,
+    stride_x_cache_dim,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # Window weights s_t = dt_t exp(A (sum dt - cumsum dt)_t) and values x_t.
+    offs_k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    dt_all = tl.load(
+        dt_cache_ptr + offs_k * stride_dt_cache_pos, mask=offs_k < wp, other=0.0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    dt_all = tl.where(offs_k == wp, dt_cur, dt_all)
+    total = A * tl.sum(dt_all, axis=0)
+    scale = dt_all * tl.exp(total - A * tl.cumsum(dt_all, axis=0))
+    scale = tl.where(offs_k <= wp, scale, 0.0)
+    x_all = tl.load(
+        x_cache_ptr
+        + offs_m[:, None] * stride_x_cache_dim
+        + offs_k[None, :] * stride_x_cache_pos,
+        mask=(offs_m[:, None] < dim) & (offs_k[None, :] < wp),
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    x_all = tl.where(offs_k[None, :] == wp, x_cur[:, None], x_all).to(tl.float32)
+    return tl.exp(total), scale, x_all

+    stride_dt_cache_slot,
+    stride_dt_cache_head,
+    stride_dt_cache_pos,
+    stride_B_cache_slot,
+    stride_B_cache_group,
+    stride_B_cache_pos,
+    stride_B_cache_dstate,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    DSTATE: tl.constexpr,
+    U_ROWS,
+    W_ROWS,
+    AG_COLS,
+    HAS_D: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_V: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # For each -1 padded flush row, one program per head folds the window into
+    # the state, S = decay S_0 + Σ_t s_t x_t (R B_t)^T with R B_t from
+    # keys_ptr, reads y = S (R C) + D x, and rebuilds the head's sketch from
+    # the new state while it is still in L2.
+    pid_h = tl.program_id(1)
+    group = pid_h // heads_per_group
+    offs_n = tl.arange(0, DSTATE)
+    offs_k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    it = tl.program_id(0)
+    row = tl.load(flush_rows_ptr + it, mask=it < batch, other=-1)
+    while row >= 0:
+        slot = tl.load(state_indices_ptr + row).to(tl.int64)
+        if slot != null_block_id:
+            wp = tl.load(write_pos_ptr + row).to(tl.int32)
+            x_ring = x_cache_ptr + slot * stride_x_cache_slot
+            x_ring += pid_h * stride_x_cache_head
+            dt_ring = dt_cache_ptr + slot * stride_dt_cache_slot
+            dt_ring += pid_h * stride_dt_cache_head
+            dt_cur = tl.load(dt_ptr + row * stride_dt_batch + pid_h * stride_dt_head)
+            dt_cur = dt_cur.to(tl.float32)
+            dt_cur += tl.load(dt_bias_ptr + pid_h * stride_dt_bias_head).to(tl.float32)
+            dt_cur = tl.where(dt_cur <= 20.0, softplus(dt_cur), dt_cur)
+            A = tl.load(A_ptr + pid_h * stride_A_head).to(tl.float32)
+            query_row = query_ptr + row * stride_query_batch
+            query_row += group * stride_query_group
+            query = tl.load(query_row + offs_n * stride_query_dstate)
+            keys = tl.load(
+                keys_ptr
+                + row.to(tl.int64) * stride_keys_batch
+                + group * stride_keys_group
+                + offs_k[:, None] * stride_keys_pos
+                + offs_n[None, :],
+                mask=offs_k[:, None] <= wp,
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            head_state = state_ptr + slot * stride_state_slot
+            head_state += pid_h * stride_state_head
+            x_row = x_ptr + row * stride_x_batch + pid_h * stride_x_head
+            out_row = out_ptr + row * stride_out_batch + pid_h * stride_out_head
+            for m0 in tl.static_range(0, DIM, BLOCK_M):
+                offs_m = m0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+                mmask = offs_m < DIM
+                x_cur = tl.load(x_row + offs_m * stride_x_dim, mask=mmask, other=0.0)
+                decay, scale, x_all = _window(
+                    dt_ring,
+                    x_ring,
+                    dt_cur,
+                    x_cur,
+                    A,
+                    wp,
+                    offs_m,
+                    DIM,
+                    stride_dt_cache_pos,
+                    stride_x_cache_pos,
+                    stride_x_cache_dim,
+                    BLOCK_K,
+                )
+                s_ptrs = (
+                    head_state
+                    + offs_m[:, None] * stride_state_dim
+                    + offs_n[None, :] * stride_state_dstate
+                )
+                # Bypass L1 so the sketch build below reads the new state.
+                s = tl.load(
+                    s_ptrs, mask=mmask[:, None], other=0.0, cache_modifier=".cg"
+                )
+                s = s * decay + tl.dot(
+                    x_all * scale[None, :], keys, input_precision=_DOT_PRECISION
+                )
+                tl.store(s_ptrs, s, mask=mmask[:, None])
+                y = tl.sum(s * query[None, :], axis=1)
+                if HAS_D:
+                    D = tl.load(D_ptr + pid_h * stride_D_head).to(tl.float32)
+                    y += x_cur.to(tl.float32) * D
+                tl.store(out_row + offs_m * stride_out_dim, y, mask=mmask)
+                # Append the current token to the ring.
+                tl.store(
+                    x_ring + wp * stride_x_cache_pos + offs_m * stride_x_cache_dim,
+                    x_cur,
+                    mask=mmask,
+                )
+            tl.store(dt_ring + wp * stride_dt_cache_pos, dt_cur)
+            if pid_h % heads_per_group == 0:
+                B_row = B_ptr + row * stride_B_batch + group * stride_B_group
+                B_ring = B_cache_ptr + slot * stride_B_cache_slot
+                B_ring += group * stride_B_cache_group
+                tl.store(
+                    B_ring + wp * stride_B_cache_pos + offs_n * stride_B_cache_dstate,
+                    tl.load(B_row + offs_n * stride_B_dstate),
+                )
+            tl.debug_barrier()
+            _sketch_head(
+                head_state,
+                tl.load(sketch_indices_ptr + row),
+                pid_h,
+                u_ptr,
+                w_ptr,
+                ag_ptr,
+                ranks_ptr,
+                u_offsets_ptr,
+                w_offsets_ptr,
+                ag_offsets_ptr,
+                stride_state_dim,
+                stride_state_dstate,
+                DIM,
+                DSTATE,
+                U_ROWS,
+                W_ROWS,
+                AG_COLS,
+                BLOCK_V,
+            )
+        it += tl.num_programs(0)
+        row = tl.load(flush_rows_ptr + it, mask=it < batch, other=-1)
+
+
+def _check_inputs(
+    state: torch.Tensor,
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    dt: torch.Tensor,
+    A: torch.Tensor,
+    B: torch.Tensor,
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    D: torch.Tensor | None,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    x_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    B_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    write_pos: torch.Tensor,
+    state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    _, heads, dim, dstate = state.shape
+    batch, groups = x.shape[0], B.shape[1]
+    window = x_cache.shape[2]
+    assert x.shape == out.shape == (batch, heads, dim)
+    assert heads % groups == 0
+    assert B.shape == (batch, groups, dstate) and B.stride(2) == 1
+    assert query.shape == B.shape and query.dtype == torch.float32
+    # dt, A, D and dt_bias are scalars per head broadcast over (dim, dstate).
+    assert dt.shape == x.shape and dt.stride(2) == 0
+    assert A.shape == (heads, dim, dstate) and A.stride(1) == A.stride(2) == 0
+    assert dt_bias.shape == (heads, dim) and dt_bias.stride(1) == 0
+    assert D is None or (D.shape == (heads, dim) and D.stride(1) == 0)
+    assert x_cache.shape[1:] == (heads, window, dim)
+    assert dt_cache.shape[1:] == (heads, window)
+    assert B_cache.shape[1:] == (groups, window, dstate) and B_cache.stride(3) == 1
+    assert write_pos.shape[0] >= batch and write_pos.dtype == torch.int32
+    assert state_indices.shape == (batch,) and state_indices.stride(0) == 1
+
+
+def _common_strides(x, dt, dt_bias, A, B, query, D, out, x_cache, dt_cache, B_cache):
+    return (
+        *x.stride(),
+        dt.stride(0),
+        dt.stride(1),
+        dt_bias.stride(0),
+        A.stride(0),
+        *B.stride(),
+        *query.stride(),
+        D.stride(0) if D is not None else 0,
+        *out.stride(),
+        *x_cache.stride(),
+        *dt_cache.stride(),
+        *B_cache.stride(),
+    )
+
+
+def sketch_bc_pre(
+    B: torch.Tensor,
+    C: torch.Tensor,
+    B_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    write_pos: torch.Tensor,
+    is_flush: torch.Tensor,
+    bc_pre: torch.Tensor,
+    state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    null_block_id: int = NULL_BLOCK_ID,
+) -> None:
+    """``bc_pre[row, group, t] = B_t · C`` over each non-flush row's window."""
+    batch, groups, dstate = B.shape
+    window = B_cache.shape[2]
+    _replayssm_output_only_precompute_kernel[(batch, groups)](
+        B,
+        C,
+        B_cache,
+        write_pos,
+        is_flush,
+        bc_pre,
+        state_indices,
+        null_block_id,
+        batch,
+        groups,
+        dstate,
+        *B.stride(),
+        *C.stride(),
+        *B_cache.stride(),
+        *bc_pre.stride(),
+        state_indices.stride(0),
+        0,
+        window,
+        triton.next_power_of_2(window),
+        num_warps=2,
+    )
+
+
+def sketch_decode(
+    state: torch.Tensor,
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    dt: torch.Tensor,
+    A: torch.Tensor,
+    B: torch.Tensor,
+    C: torch.Tensor,
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    D: torch.Tensor | None,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    x_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    B_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    bc_pre: torch.Tensor,
+    write_pos: torch.Tensor,
+    is_flush: torch.Tensor,
+    state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    sketch_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    sketch: SketchArgs,
+    null_block_id: int = NULL_BLOCK_ID,
+) -> None:
+    """Decode the non-flush rows from their sketches and the window ring.
+
+    Arguments follow ``selective_state_update_replayssm_output_only`` with
+    softplus on ``dt``; ``state`` is the ``(slots, heads, dim, dstate)`` view
+    of the key-major state, ``query`` is ``sketch_query(C)`` and
+    ``sketch_indices`` the sketch row of each batch row.
+    """
+    batch = x.shape[0]
+    if batch == 0:
+        return
+    _check_inputs(
+        state,
+        x,
+        dt,
+        A,
+        B,
+        query,
+        D,
+        dt_bias,
+        x_cache,
+        dt_cache,
+        B_cache,
+        write_pos,
+        state_indices,
+        out,
+    )
+    _, heads, dim, dstate = state.shape
+    groups, window = B.shape[1], x_cache.shape[2]
+    assert bc_pre.shape[0] >= batch and bc_pre.shape[1:] == (groups, window)
+    assert is_flush.shape[0] >= batch and sketch_indices.shape == (batch,)
+    sketch_bc_pre(
+        B, C, B_cache, write_pos, is_flush, bc_pre, state_indices, null_block_id
+    )
+    t = sketch.tables
+    block_m, block_j, num_warps = get_sketchssm_config("mamba2_decode")
+    block_m = min(block_m, triton.next_power_of_2(dim))
+    _sketch_decode_kernel[(triton.cdiv(dim, block_m), batch, heads)](
+        x,
+        dt,
+        dt_bias,
+        A,
+        B,
+        query,
+        D,
+        out,
+        x_cache,
+        dt_cache,
+        B_cache,
+        bc_pre,
+        write_pos,
+        is_flush,
+        state_indices,
+        sketch_indices,
+        sketch.u,
+        sketch.w,
+        sketch.ag,
+        t.ranks,
+        t.u_offsets,
+        t.w_offsets,
+        t.ag_offsets,
+        null_block_id,
+        dim,
+        dstate,
+        heads // groups,
+        *_common_strides(
+            x, dt, dt_bias, A, B, query, D, out, x_cache, dt_cache, B_cache
+        ),
+        *bc_pre.stride(),
+        U_ROWS=sketch.u.shape[1],
+        W_ROWS=sketch.w.shape[1],
+        AG_COLS=sketch.ag.shape[2],
+        HAS_D=D is not None,
+        BLOCK_M=block_m,
+        BLOCK_N=triton.next_power_of_2(dstate),
+        BLOCK_K=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(window)),
+        BLOCK_J=block_j,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )
+
+
+def sketch_flush(
+    state: torch.Tensor,
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    dt: torch.Tensor,
+    A: torch.Tensor,
+    B: torch.Tensor,
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    D: torch.Tensor | None,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    x_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    B_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    write_pos: torch.Tensor,
+    flush_rows: torch.Tensor,
+    state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    sketch_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    sketch: SketchArgs,
+    null_block_id: int = NULL_BLOCK_ID,
+) -> None:
+    """Flush the window of the flush rows into their states, decode them and
+    rebuild their sketches.
+
+    Arguments are those of ``sketch_decode``; ``flush_rows`` lists the flush
+    rows followed by -1 padding.
+    """
+    batch = x.shape[0]
+    if batch == 0:
+        return
+    _check_inputs(
+        state,
+        x,
+        dt,
+        A,
+        B,
+        query,
+        D,
+        dt_bias,
+        x_cache,
+        dt_cache,
+        B_cache,
+        write_pos,
+        state_indices,
+        out,
+    )
+    assert flush_rows.shape == (batch,) and flush_rows.dtype == torch.int32
+    _, heads, dim, dstate = state.shape
+    groups, window = B.shape[1], x_cache.shape[2]
+    # Programs walk the -1 padded flush row list.
+    block_m, num_warps, rows_per_program, block_v = get_sketchssm_config("mamba2_flush")
+    programs = triton.cdiv(batch, rows_per_program)
+
+    # FP32 rotated window keys R B_t of the flush rows.
+    keys = torch.empty(
+        batch, groups, window, dstate, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device
+    )
+    block_c = min(dstate, 64)
+    _window_keys_kernel[(programs, groups, dstate // block_c)](
+        B,
+        B_cache,
+        sketch.frames_t,
+        keys,
+        write_pos,
+        flush_rows,
+        state_indices,
+        null_block_id,
+        batch,
+        B.stride(0),
+        B.stride(1),
+        *B_cache.stride()[:3],
+        *keys.stride()[:3],
+        W=window,
+        N=dstate,
+        BLOCK_T=16,
+        BLOCK_C=block_c,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+
+    t = sketch.tables
+    _sketch_flush_kernel[(programs, heads)](
+        state,
+        x,
+        dt,
+        dt_bias,
+        A,
+        B,
+        query,
+        D,
+        out,
+        x_cache,
+        dt_cache,
+        B_cache,
+        keys,
+        write_pos,
+        flush_rows,
+        state_indices,
+        sketch_indices,
+        sketch.u,
+        sketch.w,
+        sketch.ag,
+        t.ranks,
+        t.u_offsets,
+        t.w_offsets,
+        t.ag_offsets,
+        null_block_id,
+        batch,
+        heads // groups,
+        *keys.stride()[:3],
+        *state.stride(),
+        *_common_strides(
+            x, dt, dt_bias, A, B, query, D, out, x_cache, dt_cache, B_cache
+        ),
+        DIM=dim,
+        DSTATE=dstate,
+        U_ROWS=sketch.u.shape[1],
+        W_ROWS=sketch.w.shape[1],
+        AG_COLS=sketch.ag.shape[2],
+        HAS_D=D is not None,
+        BLOCK_M=block_m,
+        BLOCK_K=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(window)),
+        BLOCK_V=block_v,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )

+"""Loading of SketchSSM calibrations (``--sketchssm``)."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from functools import cache
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.sketchssm import rank_allocation
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+SKETCHSSM_CALIBRATION_FILE = "calibration.pt"
+DEFAULT_SKETCHSSM_MEAN_RANK = 8.0
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SketchSSMCalibration:
+    frames: torch.Tensor  # (num_layers, ngroups, K, K) float32
+    ranks: torch.Tensor  # (num_layers, nheads) int32
+    layer_ids: tuple[int, ...]  # model layer index of each calibration row
+
+    @property
+    def num_layers(self) -> int:
+        return self.ranks.shape[0]
+
+    def layer_index(self, model_layer_idx: int) -> int:
+        """Calibration row of a model layer."""
+        if model_layer_idx not in self.layer_ids:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"SketchSSM calibration has no entry for layer {model_layer_idx}"
+            )
+        return self.layer_ids.index(model_layer_idx)
+
+
+def resolve_sketchssm_path(path_or_repo: str) -> str:
+    """Local path of ``--sketchssm``: a file, a directory or an HF repo id."""
+    path = Path(path_or_repo).expanduser()
+    if path.is_dir():
+        path = path / SKETCHSSM_CALIBRATION_FILE
+    if path.is_file():
+        return str(path)
+    if path_or_repo.endswith(".pt") or path_or_repo.startswith(("/", ".", "~")):
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"SketchSSM calibration {str(path)!r} not found")
+    from vllm.transformers_utils.repo_utils import hf_api
+
+    try:
+        return hf_api().hf_hub_download(path_or_repo, SKETCHSSM_CALIBRATION_FILE)
+    except Exception as e:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"--sketchssm {path_or_repo!r} is neither a local file nor a "
+            f"Hugging Face repo with {SKETCHSSM_CALIBRATION_FILE}: {e}"
+        ) from e
+
+
+@cache
+def load_sketchssm_calibration(
+    path_or_repo: str, mean_rank: float | None, window: int
+) -> SketchSSMCalibration:
+    """Load the ``--sketchssm`` calibration, shared by all layers (cached)."""
+    path = resolve_sketchssm_path(path_or_repo)
+    data = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+    if rank_allocation.is_portable_calibration(data):
+        if mean_rank is None:
+            mean_rank = DEFAULT_SKETCHSSM_MEAN_RANK
+        frames, ranks = rank_allocation.frames_for_mean_rank(data, mean_rank, window)
+        logger.info(
+            "SketchSSM calibration %s: mean rank %g at window %d, %d sketch and %d "
+            "dense heads",
+            path_or_repo,
+            mean_rank,
+            window,
+            int((ranks > 0).sum()),
+            int((ranks == 0).sum()),
+        )
+    else:
+        if mean_rank is not None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"SketchSSM calibration {path_or_repo!r} holds exported frames whose "
+                "ranks are already fixed; --sketchssm-mean-rank applies only to a "
+                "portable calibration file"
+            )
+        frames = data["frames"].to(torch.float32)
+        ranks = data["m_table"].to(torch.int32)
+        if frames.dim() != 4 or frames.shape[-1] != frames.shape[-2]:
+            raise ValueError("SketchSSM frames must be (layers, groups, K, K)")
+        if ranks.dim() != 2 or ranks.shape[0] != frames.shape[0]:
+            raise ValueError("SketchSSM m_table must be (layers, heads)")
+        if ranks.shape[1] % frames.shape[1] != 0:
+            raise ValueError("SketchSSM heads must divide evenly into groups")
+        if (ranks < 0).any() or (ranks > frames.shape[-1]).any():
+            raise ValueError("SketchSSM ranks must lie in [0, K]")
+        eye = torch.eye(frames.shape[-1], dtype=torch.float64)
+        frames64 = frames.double()
+        if (frames64 @ frames64.mT - eye).abs().amax() > 1e-4:
+            raise ValueError("SketchSSM frames are not orthogonal")
+    layer_ids = data.get("layer_ids")
+    if layer_ids is None or len(layer_ids) != ranks.shape[0]:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"SketchSSM calibration {path_or_repo!r} must list the model layer of "
+            "each of its rows in layer_ids"
+        )
+    return SketchSSMCalibration(
+        frames=frames.contiguous(),
+        ranks=ranks.contiguous(),
+        layer_ids=tuple(int(i) for i in layer_ids),
+    )
